folds.LORO: 309 T1/T2/T3 reach holdouts; remove the entire evaluation reach from training TN and refit all process and remaining-site parameters
folds.LOTO: 21 T1/T2/T3 terminal-tree holdouts; remove the entire evaluation tree from training TN and refit all process and remaining-site parameters
folds.FIRST_OBSERVED_2021: train only 2016-2020 established stations and evaluate stations first observed in 2021

optimizer.LORO_LOTO: matching temporal-fold solution as numerical start followed by 35-step strong-Wolfe LBFGS on the reduced training data
optimizer.FIRST_OBSERVED_2021: three generic starts, 60 AdamW plus 80 LBFGS; no 2021-derived initialization

prediction.conditional: unavailable for every held-out station; must equal population numerically where materialized

gates.relative: LORO and LOTO paired block bootstrap CI95 upper candidate-minus-parent macro log-RMSE < 0.005
gates.absolute: LORO and LOTO station-blind Skill_log bootstrap CI95 lower > 0
gates.boundary: extra-parameter boundary frequency <=5% separately in LORO and LOTO
gates.natural_expansion: reported stress test, not a standalone promotion gate
gates.tree_163: open-lake-center diagnostic domain excluded from the formal river gate

checkpoint: atomic per model after every completed fold; safe resume by fold_id
successor_rule: Only candidates passing both relative and absolute LORO/LOTO gates remain spatially eligible.
